description: RRRR rapid realtime routing provides a C implementation of the RAPTOR transit routing algorithm used in the Bliksem journey planner. The provider is Bliksem Labs. Geographical and temporal coverage: The project targets large areas such as Benelux and Europe; real-time support is partly described as a future goal. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is BSD-2-Clause. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: Features expressed as future objectives in the README should not be treated as implemented capabilities. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
